inv.desc_en:
REF: 6158900

Inmo Olaya offers you this Bar C1 Transfer in an excellent area of l'Eixample Izquierdo, Barcelona. Very close to the Hospital Clínic and the Industrial School, surrounded by many office buildings, metro and bus stop very close.

This restaurant Bar C1 with a 3-meter linear facade and a toilet
It has 32m2 with a capacity for 16 people, plus 12 pax on the terrace and with a fixed clientele.

The restaurant is in perfect condition with a loyal clientele. The license is old, as it allows a gas griddle, ideal for making different types of cuisine.

It is ideal to run it between two people, newly renovated with a new age style.

It has: 1 horizontal 5-door refrigerator, 1 3-door bottle rack, 1 vertical freezer, 1 electric oven, 1 microwave, 1 gas griddle, 2 gas burners, 1 POS, coffee furniture, coffee maker + grinders (supplier), 1 dishwasher, 1 TV, air conditioning H/C and music equipment.

Transfer 60,000€ and rent 805€ plus VAT with a 10-year contract

Managed by InmoOlaya

InmoOlaya, leading agency in hospitality transfers, please contact us, or visit our portal; you will find the largest selection of restaurants and hospitality businesses for transfer in Barcelona. An advisor will accompany you throughout the process, saving you time and selecting the best businesses for your project.
